result: FAIL: missing optional host toolInfo prevents recovery
notes: First record is exploratory setup: unsupported generic-role trace selector timed out; initial read1 cancelled while setting up.
After explicit reset, host B error at 13:54:29.978 and final observation at 13:58:43.043 show zero received RPC requests. Clicking old A move sent no mutation.
Host document visibility was visible; iframe contentDocument was unavailable in that read-only lookup, so it does not prove iframe visibility. Console warn/error list was empty.
Expected retry assertion and locator waits failed; these are not PASS. No page state, event, timer or timeout was modified.
Screenshot was viewed by parent. QA tab closed and Vite stopped before executor correction.
